note: Coefficients per N1 parameter version; calib.py applies the set matching live.LIVE_PARAMS and refuses any other. Logit clips are the ones each layer was fitted with (V4 1e-4, anchored 1e-6).

nba-0.1.fitted_on: NBA 2024-25 regular season, 71,922 props with US lines 3 h before tip (n10 rows), frozen nba-0.1 N1

calibration_v4.form: logit p_cal = a + b * logit(p_model), per market
calibration_v4.note: V11 (more terms) was the variant chosen and tested once (0.68793); V4 is within 0.0003 in CV and simpler; its test score is a disclosed second look

anchored_stack.form: logit p = a + c * logit(market fair_over) + w * logit(p_model), per market
anchored_stack.tracking_rule: side with the higher expected value; track when p * price - 1 >= 0.02 (BetMGM price where BetMGM quotes the consensus line, else best price, flagged)
anchored_stack.status: paper tracking only; not shown as bets (D-043)
